# Overview

Respiratory illnesses became a major focus of healthcare planning following the COVID-19 pandemic. This project uses healthcare data to examine factors associated with respiratory illness risk and mortality.

The goal was to transform complex healthcare data into an interactive visualization that could communicate risk patterns to both healthcare providers and patients.
